falsification_conditions.condition: Price closes below the 2020 December breakout's support level (defined as 10% below the pattern's lowest point) for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Confirms a breakdown rather than a breakout, directly contradicting the pattern's expected directional bias

falsification_conditions.condition: Volume exceeds 200% of the 30-day average volume for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Indicates extreme market participation inconsistent with a HOLD signal, suggesting a potential blowoff or reversal phase

falsification_conditions.condition: The blowoff score increases to 70+ within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Confirms a high-pressure market environment that invalidates the current HOLD signal and suggests a different phase than the 2020 pattern

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
